The '''Yuuzhan Vong tender''' was a shiptype in the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]].

==History==
The tenders were part of a massive armada heading for [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]]. They were part of the columns of ships that formed a fortified center of the armada.
